title: TransMem — paper view
subtitle: In-forward-pass hidden-state injection with an offline self-distillation training regime (ECSD). Lane = canonical stage; only A1 (boundary), A5, A6, B6, B7 carry content — the other nine lanes are empty because this mechanism has no discrete write step and no discrete retrieve step.
source: Lei et al. 2026, TransMem (arXiv:2607.29032v1)   ·   every anchor re-located in the paper txt during verification (servers/transmem/verification.md, 50 paper-side assertions: 41 correct / 1 wrong / 8 partial)
legend_notes: Only 4 of 14 lanes have real content, plus a boundary A1 node. B1-B5 and A2-A4 are empty because there is no discrete write step and no discrete retrieve step: the entire recall+shift+gate+inject chain (Eq.4-7) runs inside one frozen forward pass and all of it lands on B6 DELIVER.

B6 delivers via P-INJECT — a gated residual on hidden states (h_hat = h + g*Delta h), one of only three delivery mechanisms across all 14 systems in this study (the others being P-ASSEMBLE and P-INTERP).

New primitive P-ACTSELECT (drawn as Sched:MemSelect): pick B segment-end positions from already-computed hidden states H_C. No encoding forward, no (key,value) structure, nothing persisted — this is the system's entire 'write' step.
tau (gate temperature, Eq.6) is used but never given a numeric value anywhere in the paper (txt:275, 277, 1059) — left as a bare symbol here since verification could not resolve it either.
